title: "Scale3D"

<!-- DO NOT EDIT! This file was auto-generated by crates/build/dl_types_builder/src/codegen/docs/website.rs -->

A 3D scale factor.

A scale of 1.0 means no scaling.
A scale of 2.0 means doubling the size.
Each component scales along the corresponding axis.

## Dalaran datatype
[`Vec3D`](../datatypes/vec3d.md)


## Arrow datatype
```
FixedSizeList(3 x non-null Float32)
```
